title: Royal Canadian Air Force Crew - Vickers Wellington BK387
memorial_details: Stone of Remembrance with rampant arched upper edge. Badge of Royal Canadian Air Force top centre. Incised inscription infilled with black paint. (See also wmr 28929)
inscription: Badge: PER ARDUA AD ASTRA / ROYAL CANADIAN AIR FORCE / Inscription: ROYAL CANADIAN AIR FORCE / IN MEMORY OF / (6 NAMES) / WHO LOST THEIR LIVES ON THIS SITE / JANUARY 2ND 1944.
community_connection: memorial for those who lost their lives on this site
